verdict.rationale: Recurly is a subscription billing platform, so user-defined scheduled jobs or automations are a fair question for it. The evidence only shows domain-specific billing automation: subscription billing cycles, end-of-cycle usage charges, and dunning retry timing. These are adjacent features, not a documented capability for users or agents to schedule their own recurring jobs or workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
